name: Ismail Marzuki
complainant: Nawal Lubis (wife of the Governor of North Sumatra), through her legal representative
outcome_detail: Named a suspect on 24 May 2021; not detained during investigation or trial. Convicted 27 April 2023 under Art. 27(3) and sentenced to six months imprisonment (Medan District Court No. 776/Pid.Sus/2022/PN Mdn); also charged in the alternative under Criminal Code Art. 310(2). Ismail Marzuki and the prosecution appealed to the Medan Court of Appeals, with the prosecution requesting a heavier sentence. The appeal (No. 737/PID.SUS/2023/PT MDN) upheld that verdict on 13 July 2023. Detik, citing the Medan court register (SIPP), describes the upheld sentence as six months that did not have to be served, with an eight-month probation period, plus a fine of Rp 10 million or one month. In August 2023 he submitted a cassation application to the Supreme Court, which the CFJ report says appears to have been dismissed in June 2024.

name: Roy Suryo
role: former Minister of Youth and Sports
outcome_detail: Convicted 28 December 2022 under Art. 28(2) and sentenced to 9 months (West Jakarta District Court No. 890/Pid.Sus/2022/PN.Jkt.Brt; day of sentencing from USCIRF). Also charged in the alternative with Criminal Code Art. 156a and Law 1/1946 Art. 15(1); convicted only under 28(2). Jakarta Court of Appeal upheld the conviction on 10 February 2023 and added a fine of IDR 150,000,000 or 2 months if unpaid. Supreme Court rejected cassation on 2 May 2023. USCIRF reports he was released on 2 May 2023 after completing his sentence. Kevin Wu of Dharmapala Nusantara also reported him to Bareskrim; the case proceeded on Kurniawan Santoso's complaint.

name: Dr. Richard Lee
outcome_detail: Pretrial ruling of 14 Nov 2022 (South Jakarta District Court, single judge, Case No. 99/Pid.Pra/2022/PN JKT.SEL), granted in full: the defamation investigation (ITE Art. 27(3) and 36, Penal Code 310 and 311), the suspect designation under police report LP/7463/XII/YAN.2.5/2020/SPKT PMJ of 16 Dec 2020, a separate illegal-access investigation and suspect designations, and the seizures were declared invalid; rehabilitation ordered. Reason given: the suspect designation lacked sufficient preliminary evidence. The court also held that Art. 27(3) is an absolute complaint offence the victim must report personally (applying the 2021 Joint Decree), and that the report here was made by a lawyer under a power of attorney. Not the same proceeding as the 2024-26 consumer-protection case.
source: CFJ EIT report Legal Analysis (defamation) (PDF p.37, printed p.75, fn 308-309) | Putusan PN Jakarta Selatan 99/Pid.Pra/2022/PN JKT.SEL, 14 Nov 2022 (Direktori Putusan Mahkamah Agung; decision pp. 96-98, 101-102, 105-106, 108-110)

name: Wahyu Dwi Nugroho
complainant: Majelis Taklim Al-Busyro (religious study group), reported to Polda Metro Jaya; a member filed as reporter
outcome_detail: TikTok post (31 Jul 2022) of a photo of a banner telling members of the Al-Busyro religious study group not to shop at nearby stalls, with his own captions, plus his replies to comments. The group reported the account to Polda Metro Jaya. Detained from 15 Mar 2023. Convicted on 10 Aug 2023 (South Jakarta District Court, No. 283/Pid.Sus/2023/PN Jkt.Sel, deliberated 7 Aug) of intentionally spreading information to cause hatred or hostility against a group based on ethnicity, religion, race or inter-group (ITE Art. 28(2), penalty under Art. 45(2) of Law 19/2016): 5 months in prison and a fine of Rp 1,000,000 (15 days confinement if unpaid); time under arrest and detention deducted and ordered to remain detained. Prosecutors had asked for 5 months and Rp 2,000,000. The court named harm to the study group as aggravating, and no prior conviction, being the family breadwinner and apologising in court as mitigating. Release on 11 Aug 2023 is from Manushya Foundation, not the decision.
source: South Jakarta District Court decision 283/Pid.Sus/2023/PN Jkt.Sel (23 pp: pp.2-5 charge and testimony, pp.21-22 verdict) | CFJ EIT report Legal Analysis (hate speech) (PDF pp.43-44, printed pp.81-82) | https://www.manushyafoundation.org/post/indonesia-small-business-owner-wahyu-dwi-nugroho-s-conviction-challenges-free-speech

name: Khariq Anhar
complainant: Baringin Jaya Tobing (police report LP/B/6073/VIII/2025/SPKT/POLDA METRO JAYA, Aug 27 2025)
outcome_detail: Edited ('timpa teks') screenshot of a news post about labor leader Said Iqbal during the Aug 2025 protests. Charged under the ITE Law as amended by Law 1/2024, Arts. 32 and 35 (altering electronic information), not defamation or hate speech. Arrested Aug 29 2025 at the airport. Amnesty says the same image was examined in an earlier case that ended in an acquittal, after which prosecutors brought a new case under different ITE articles. Per Amnesty Indonesia (Aug 10 2026): on Jan 23 2026 the court accepted his objection, declared the indictment void and returned the file to prosecutors, who refiled in Feb (indictment read Feb 10); the same court found him not guilty of incitement in the protest case with Delpedro Marhaen, Muzaffar Salim and Syahdan Husein (date not given). Amnesty states that Said Iqbal, named in the edited text, was not the person who reported him; whether Said Iqbal objected to the post is not sourced. Prosecutors demanded 6 months less time served on Aug 10 2026. Verdict Oct 7 2026 (Central Jakarta District Court): 5 months (prosecutors sought 6), two phones seized, Instagram account @aliansimahasiswapenggugat ordered destroyed. Appeal window about one week (to about Oct 14); appeal status not confirmed. Defendant says on Threads the vote was 2:1 with the presiding judge dissenting - unverified claim. Verdict found in one outlet so far (RCTI+ citing Sindonews).
source: RCTI+ https://www.rctiplus.com/news/detail/nasional/5488645/khariq-anhar-dihukum-5-bulan-penjara-terkait-kasus-timpa-teks-demo-agustus-2025 | Amnesty https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/asa21/1300/2026/en/ | Hukumonline https://www.hukumonline.com/berita/a/pegiat-medsos-khariq-anhar-ditangkap-polisi--koalisi--indikasi-bentuk-pembungkaman-dan-kriminalisasi-lt68b583958efa8 | Amnesty Indonesia press release https://www.amnesty.id/kabar-terbaru/siaran-pers/bebaskan-khariq-anhar-dari-tuntutan-penjara/08/2026/ | Khariq Anhar Threads posts (screenshot shared by team, about Oct 8-9 2026)

name: Laras Faizati Khairunnisa
role: communications officer (organization affiliated with the ASEAN secretariat)
complainant: Muhammad Lutfi (citizen who saw the post; single source: Supreme Court Marinews)
outcome_detail: Instagram Story calling to burn the police headquarters building during the Aug 2025 unrest. Indicted with alternative charges: ITE Art. 45A(2) jo 28(2), or Penal Code Art. 160, or Art. 161(1); convicted under Art. 161(1) (fourth alternative), not under the ITE Law (confirm which Penal Code version the court applied). South Jakarta District Court, presiding judge I Ketut Darpawan, Jan 15 2026: 6 months served as a supervision sentence (pidana pengawasan) with one year of supervision, released at once; prosecutors sought 1 year. Judges cited a first offence and the new Penal Code preference against imprisonment. Amnesty called it prison without bars; a DPR member called it proof the new Penal Code is reformist.
